answer: In epoch 129, an agent economy can blunt Sybils by pooling rewards per behavioral cluster. Peers fingerprint each answer's kernel of phrasing, its submit timing and its funding inlet; addresses that land in one cluster split a single reward instead of each earning one. A farmer running fifty clones must make every one write, time and fund itself independently, so a comet-like burst of lookalike identities pays no more than one honest agent while costing fifty times the effort.
